# Exit codes

One table for every command. The same lines are in each command's `--help`
and in `exit_codes` of `evnx commands --json`.

| Code | Id | Meaning | Commands |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `ok` | Ran, nothing to report | every command |
| 1 | `findings` | Ran, and found something: findings, problems, a difference, not in sync | `remove`, `get`, `validate`, `scan`, `scan rules test`, `diff`, `migrate`, `sync`, `align`, `vault revoke`, `cloud diff`, `platform diff`, `platform push`, `doctor`, `spec check`, `parse`, `update` |
| 2 | `error` | Could not run: usage, config, I/O, or refused before any change | every command |
| 4 | `declined` | Declined: answered no, or a confirmation was needed with no terminal and no --yes | `init`, `add` and its subcommands, `remove`, `set`, `get`, `scan rules update`, `migrate`, `sync`, `restore`, `auth token revoke`, `auth sessions revoke`, `auth sessions revoke-others`, `auth devices disavow`, `auth rotate-master-password`, `org seats`, `org remove`, `org delete`, `org leave`, `vault delete`, `vault revoke`, `vault rekey`, `vault leave`, `cloud push`, `cloud pull`, `cloud delete-version`, `platform pull`, `platform push`, `undo` |
| 5 | `restored_aside` | restore wrote the result aside, to <output>.restored | `restore` |
| 10 | `not_signed_in` | Not signed in, or the token was rejected | `auth` and its subcommands, `org` and its subcommands, `vault` and its subcommands, `cloud push`, `cloud pull`, `cloud run`, `cloud history`, `cloud watch`, `cloud diff`, `cloud audit`, `cloud delete-version`, `cloud link`, `cloud export`, `cloud status`, `platform` and its subcommands |
| 11 | `forbidden` | Forbidden, or the email is not verified | `auth` and its subcommands, `org` and its subcommands, `vault` and its subcommands, `cloud push`, `cloud pull`, `cloud run`, `cloud history`, `cloud watch`, `cloud diff`, `cloud audit`, `cloud delete-version`, `cloud link`, `cloud export`, `cloud status`, `platform` and its subcommands |
| 12 | `plan_limit` | The plan's limit is reached | `auth` and its subcommands, `org` and its subcommands, `vault` and its subcommands, `cloud push`, `cloud pull`, `cloud run`, `cloud history`, `cloud watch`, `cloud diff`, `cloud audit`, `cloud delete-version`, `cloud link`, `cloud export`, `cloud status` |
| 13 | `unreachable` | Server unreachable, not an evnx server, or TLS roots unusable | `auth` and its subcommands, `org` and its subcommands, `vault` and its subcommands, `cloud push`, `cloud pull`, `cloud run`, `cloud history`, `cloud watch`, `cloud diff`, `cloud audit`, `cloud delete-version`, `cloud link`, `cloud export`, `cloud status`, `platform` and its subcommands |
| 14 | `conflict` | Conflict, or locked | `auth` and its subcommands, `org` and its subcommands, `vault` and its subcommands, `cloud push`, `cloud pull`, `cloud run`, `cloud history`, `cloud watch`, `cloud diff`, `cloud audit`, `cloud delete-version`, `cloud link`, `cloud export`, `cloud status`, `platform push` |
| 15 | `server_error` | Server error, or rate limited | `auth` and its subcommands, `org` and its subcommands, `vault` and its subcommands, `cloud push`, `cloud pull`, `cloud run`, `cloud history`, `cloud watch`, `cloud diff`, `cloud audit`, `cloud delete-version`, `cloud link`, `cloud export`, `cloud status`, `platform` and its subcommands |
| 141 | `broken_pipe` | Output closed early (broken pipe) | every command |

`cloud run` and `run`: once the command has started, evnx exits with the command's own code, or 128+n when signal n killed it (the shell's rule).

A code means the same everywhere: `2` is never a finding, and `1` never a failure to run.

`get` answers with them too: `1` is a name that is not in the file (also `get --exists`), and `4` a secret read without `--reveal`. `set` exits `4` when it needs a value or an answer and there is no terminal and nothing on stdin.
